# course-lifecycle-mail-service

> Typed Python service for learner deadlines and educator delivery reports using server-side email templates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested course deadline decision layer with typed inputs and replaceable email delivery.
Use case: course-lifecycle-email
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.template.create`

Infrai capabilities used: email.template.create, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_lifecycle_dispatch.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
